description: ✨🏠 This exceptional mansion, a 9-minute walk from Parc Monceau and a 15-minute metro ride from the Arc de Triomphe and Champs-Élysées, offers a luxurious setting. 20 minutes from the Tuileries by metro, this upscale home has 5 comfortable double bedrooms, 5 modern bathrooms, a hammam, a movie theater, a dressing room and an office. Perfect for hosting all members of your group in a spacious and unique space where everyone will feel at home.The space🏠 Private mansion🛋️ Large, bright and modern living room🍿 Movie theater🧖‍♀️ Hammam 📺 TV & Wi-Fi🍳 Large kitchen equipped with stove, microwave, oven, Nespresso coffee machine, kettle🍽️ Dining room for 8 people🛏️ 5 comfortable double bedrooms 🛏️ Folding baby crib available in the apartment🧺 Washer and dryer2 bathrooms 3 shower rooms ToiletGuest access🔑The keys to the apartment will be handed to you personally.Other things to note🏙️ The 16th arrondissement of Paris is a must-see destination for tourists. This arrondissement offers a rich variety of cultural and historical attractions, such as the Musée Marmottan Monet, the Arc de Triomphe and the Palais de Tokyo. Tourists can also enjoy many parks, such as the Bois de Boulogne and the Parc des Princes. Shopping enthusiasts can stroll through the neighborhood's shopping streets, while food lovers will find their happiness in the many bars and restaurants. Finally, nature lovers can discover the botanical gardens and ponds of the arrondissement. The 16th arrondissement of Paris is a rich and varied destination that will delight tourists.🍽️RESTAURANTS Molitor (French)Treize (French)Les Petites Mains (French)La Grande Cascade (French)L'auberge du Bonheur (French)Octave (French)Le Petit Rétro (English)Le Petit Victor Hugo (French)Masha (French)Sorello (Italian)☕️BARS & CAFÉSLe Belair
